parameters.content:
## 📅 WHATSAPP APPOINTMENT BOOKING + RECALL
**What it does:** FLOW A — a WhatsApp message arrives → AI understands the booking intent → checks Google Calendar availability → books / cancels / reschedules → replies on WhatsApp, every step logged in Google Sheets → Telegram digest. FLOW B — every Monday, customers inactive 60+ days get a WhatsApp winback message → sheet flips to `RECALLED` → Telegram digest.

**You'll need:**
- WhatsApp Business API via Meta (developers.facebook.com → WhatsApp → test number or your business number)
- OpenAI API key (platform.openai.com)
- Google Calendar + Google Sheets OAuth2 credentials
- Telegram bot token + your chat ID (@BotFather → /newbot)

**Status flow (Bookings tab):** `RECEIVED` → `BOOKED` / `PENDING_SLOT` / `CANCELLED` / `RESCHEDULE_REQUESTED` / `HANDLED`
**Recall flow (Customers tab):** inactive 60+ days → WhatsApp re-engagement → `RECALLED`

## STEP 1 — WhatsApp trigger + AI intent parsing
New WhatsApp message → CONFIG — Business → log a row with status `RECEIVED` → AI Agent classifies intent (book / cancel / reschedule / other) via a Structured Output Parser → Switch routes by intent.

## STEP 2 — Calendar availability + booking
book → build a ±1h availability window → fetch overlapping Google Calendar events → Code decides if the slot is free → IF free: create the event → sheet `BOOKED` → WhatsApp confirmation. IF busy: propose 3 alternative 1-hour slots → WhatsApp suggestions → sheet `PENDING_SLOT`.

## STEP 3 — Cancel / reschedule / fallback
cancel → find the customer's upcoming event (phone in description, else name in summary) → delete it → sheet `CANCELLED` → WhatsApp confirmation. reschedule → ask for the new preferred time → sheet `RESCHEDULE_REQUESTED` (customer replies to continue the booking flow). other → business-hours fallback reply → sheet `HANDLED`.

## STEP 4 — Weekly inactive-customer recall
Every Monday 10 AM → read the Customers tab → Code keeps customers whose Last Visit is 60+ days ago → WhatsApp re-engagement message per customer → sheet `RECALLED` + Last Contact date → Telegram digest.

⚠️ NOTE: Meta requires an APPROVED message template for business-initiated WhatsApp messages. Keep the text simple and get your template approved in WhatsApp Manager before activating.

## STEP 5 — Sheets logging + Telegram digests
Every booking branch merges → one booking summary is built → Telegram. The weekly recall builds its own digest → Telegram. Both digests read the chat ID from CONFIG — Notifications.

options.systemMessage:
=You are the friendly receptionist for {{ $('CONFIG — Business').first().json.business_name }}. A customer just wrote on WhatsApp. Extract their booking intent precisely:
- 'book' = they want a NEW appointment (with or without a date/time)
- 'cancel' = they want to CANCEL an existing appointment
- 'reschedule' = they want to MOVE an existing appointment to another time
- 'other' = anything else (opening hours, prices, greetings, questions)

Today is {{ $now.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd') }} and the business timezone is {{ $('CONFIG — Business').first().json.timezone }}. Convert any mentioned date/time into ISO 8601 in that timezone (assume upcoming dates when ambiguous). Leave customer_name empty if no name is given. Output ONLY via the structured output parser.

=I couldn't find an upcoming appointment for this number. 😕 Please reply with the date/time of the appointment you'd like to cancel (e.g. "cancel my appointment tomorrow 4pm").
=No problem! 🔁 Your current appointment stays as-is for now. Please reply with your NEW preferred date and time, and I'll move it for you.

=Hello from {{ $('CONFIG — Business').first().json.business_name }}! 👋

I can help you:
• BOOK — schedule a new appointment
• CANCEL — cancel an existing one
• RESCHEDULE — move an existing one

Just reply with what you'd like to do!
